summary.zh: 查询云上数据库与表结构
summary.en: Query cloud databases and table schemas

description.zh: 对 ClickHouse Cloud 服务执行只读 SQL 查询，浏览数据库与表结构。适合数据探查和报表核对。首次连接用 ClickHouse Cloud 账号授权并选择服务。
description.en: Run read-only SQL against a ClickHouse Cloud service and browse databases and table schemas. Useful for data exploration and checking reported numbers. Authorize with your ClickHouse Cloud account and pick a service on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 ClickHouse Cloud 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to ClickHouse Cloud and authorize on first connect
